details: Update storm: both slider `input` handlers call `render()` synchronously on every mousemove, which destroys and redraws all SVG sparklines and bullet charts (via `svg.selectAll('*').remove()`) across 20 rows at 60fps with no debounce or RAF coalescing. Handoff race: `animateRows` applies CSS transitions without clearing prior in-flight transitions, so rapid slider drags during an animated sort leave stale `transitionend` listeners that never fire, leaking the `transitioning` class on rows.
